L-unattended-fleet-no-self-heal.name: Unattended agent fleet loses work at runtime boundaries with no durable replay, liveness sweep or idempotent recovery
L-unattended-fleet-no-self-heal.mechanism: A fleet of coding bots runs overnight: a server wakes each bot through a chat gateway, the bot runs a capped agent session in a worktree and reports back over one HTTP callback. Every boundary is fire-and-forget. A config or system-prompt re-render restarts the gateway and its drain drops inbound wakes with no replay; a 502 on the result callback leaves the session marked running and its slot held for an hour; a run hits its turn cap and waits for a human nobody is watching; the sweeper keeps retrying a known-broken path and exhausts its retry budget minutes before the fix lands. The human then recovers by hand (unassign/reassign loops, hand-written watchers), and non-idempotent recovery over-dispatches work that was already woken. Throughput is set by how fast someone notices, not by the bots.
trigger_signals: bots woken by chat messages or webhooks with no server-side record of unacknowledged wakes
a run reports completion through a single HTTP callback with no retry, heartbeat or stale-slot reaper
a server-side change (system-prompt re-render, config) that restarts the bot gateway while lanes are live
unattended agent runs with a turn or budget cap below the task size
recovering lost work by toggling assignment or status in a loop
deploying a fix to a path an automated sweep or retry loop is still hitting
an overnight or multi-hour fleet run supervised only by a human or by ad hoc watchers
preventive_checks: Before the first unattended night, make every hop durable: wakes queued server-side and replayed until acknowledged, result callbacks retried, live runs heartbeated, and a timer sweep that reaps stale slots and re-wakes lost work
Recovery must be idempotent: re-wake only items confirmed lost through an explicit re-wake call, never by unassign/reassign loops; assert the wake count stays under the lane cap
Auto-continue runs that stop on a turn or budget cap up to a lane budget, then escalate to a human instead of idling
Pause the sweep or reset its retry counters before deploying a fix to the path it retries
Run one supervision loop on a schedule (launchd/systemd or a scheduled agent) that checks every lane's state, heartbeat age and queue, instead of hand-written watchers per incident

L-test-result-verdict-misreported.name: Test-result reporting collapses, filters or duplicates results so the run's verdict misstates what executed
L-test-result-verdict-misreported.mechanism: Automated test results flow from a runner (JUnit, Playwright JSON) through a push CLI into a test-management ingest that maps many tests to one case. Each hop silently reshapes the verdict: ingest keeps one result per case (highest attempt, first on tie) so a failing test hides behind a passing one; a scoped run serializes every filtered-out test as skipped, and the UI counts skipped as complete, so 6 passed out of 182 reads as 100%; the scoped command runs one runner and misses e2e specs tagged to the same case; a wrapper pushes twice and creates duplicate runs; an evidence flag uploads nothing without its companion flag. Requirements turn green on evidence that does not exist.
trigger_signals: many automated tests mapped to one test case or requirement (case-id tags, name patterns)
a dedupe or winner-selection step in a result ingest keyed on attempt, order or timestamp
a scoped or filtered test run (-t, --grep, tag filter) whose report is pushed as a run
case tags spread across several runners (unit, API e2e, browser e2e) while the scoped command calls one
a QA bot or CI wrapper that pushes results and may retry or be invoked twice
progress or coverage percentages that count skipped as executed
preventive_checks: Collapse many results per case with worst-result-wins (failed > blocked > passed > skipped) within and across chunks, and test a case with one passing and one failing test
Push only executed tests from a scoped run (or flag the run as scoped); keep skipped distinct from untested and exclude skipped from pass percentages
Build the scoped command from every runner's specs tagged to the case and assert the executed count matches the tagged count
Make result pushes idempotent on an external run id and assert one run per ticket round
After a push, read the run back: totals, executed vs skipped, evidence count, and compare them with the runner's own summary

agent-fleet-lanes.title: Run or supervise a fleet of coding bots in delivery lanes (implement, review, QA) that merge PRs into a shared branch
agent-fleet-lanes.description: Autonomous multi-bot delivery: implementer, reviewer and QA bots woken per ticket, parallel PRs merged into a shared dev/integration branch, overnight unattended runs, wake delivery, result callbacks, lane prompts, supervision and recovery.

test-result-reporting.title: Run QA tests and push results (JUnit, evidence) into test management; ingest and report results per case
test-result-reporting.description: A QA bot or CI job runs scoped or full tests, pushes JUnit/Playwright results and evidence through a CLI, and a test-management ingest maps results to cases, runs and requirement coverage.
